series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Through 2009, market share for the top 10 IT outsourcers will decline to 40.0% (from 43.5% now), equaling a revenue shift of $5.4 billion.
entries.subject: IT outsourcing market concentration
entries.note: From 43.5% at time of writing; revenue shift of $5.4 billion.

entries.quote: Only one Asia/Pacific-based service provider will make the global top 20 through 2010.
entries.subject: Asia/Pacific IT service providers

entries.quote: Blogging and community contributors will peak in the first half of 2007.
entries.subject: Blogging
entries.note: Peak of blogging and community contributors in the first half of 2007.

entries.quote: By 2009, corporate social responsibility (CSR) will be a higher board- and executive-level priority than regulatory compliance.
entries.subject: Corporate social responsibility

entries.quote: By the end of 2007, 75% of enterprises will be infected with undetected, financially motivated, targeted malware that evaded their traditional perimeter and host defenses.
entries.subject: Targeted malware
entries.metric: share of enterprises infected with undetected targeted malware

entries.quote: Vista will be the last major release of Microsoft Windows.
entries.subject: Microsoft Windows release model

entries.quote: By 2010, the average total cost of ownership (TCO) of new PCs will fall by 50%.
entries.subject: PC total cost of ownership
entries.metric: reduction in average TCO of new PCs

entries.quote: By 2010, 60% of the worldwide cellular population will be “trackable” via an emerging “follow-me Internet.”
entries.subject: Mobile phone location tracking
entries.metric: share of worldwide cellular population trackable

entries.quote: Through 2011, enterprises will waste $100 billion buying the wrong networking technologies and services.
entries.subject: Networking technology spending waste
entries.metric: wasted spending on wrong networking technologies

entries.quote: By 2008, nearly 50% of data centers worldwide will lack the necessary power and cooling capacity to support high-density equipment.
entries.subject: Data center power and cooling
entries.metric: share of data centers lacking power and cooling capacity

notes: Edition covers '2007 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: '10 key predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions. Client report: "Gartner's Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users, 2007 and Beyond" (paywalled). Read from a verbatim press copy on insurance-canada.ca (Stamford dateline). The Gartner original was not located. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
